description: An eight step voltage sequencer, one knob per step, clocked forward from a jack

params.text: Sets the voltage this step puts out, -5V to 5V

inputs.text: Moves to the next step on each rising edge above 1V, wrapping round after the eighth
Sends the sequence back so the next clock plays the first step; until that clock arrives the output is not any of the eight step voltages

outputs.text: The voltage of the step the sequencer is on, -5V to 5V, held until it moves on

notes: nothing moves until a clock reaches IN; with none patched, the output holds the first step's knob

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
unipolar · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
